limitations: The base graph is connected with invertible real adjacency; only its independent-set blow-ups and real evolution algebras are covered. The original graph may have arbitrary adjacency nullity. No statement covers arbitrary singular false-twin-free bases.
scientific_integrity: A rigorous real-algebra theorem with a supplementary, non-exhaustive finite checker. The result is not independently audited.
title: Twin-quotient rigidity for graph and random-walk evolution algebras
